records.subtitle: S1E1 "Shaytana's Eye" and later episodes
records.meta: TV fantasy series · New Zealand · English
records.mechanism: Sorcerer's crystal (Shaytana's Eye) hypnosis; dream projection
records.confidence_flag: Medium-high · episode recap + TV Tropes + episode listings
records.summary: Sorcerer Kreel and Lord Xax seize the kingdom of Kale. Kreel uses Shaytana's Eye to hypnotise Princess Vara so she trusts Xax as 'Lord Protector' and doesn't want to be rescued; he does it at least three times, once by planting dreams in her mind.
